files.delete_body: It goes from Files for everyone on this account, right away. This can't be undone.
files.delete_copy_stays: The copy the taf sent to {place} stays there.
files.empty: Nothing yet. When a taf makes a report, a sheet or a document in a run, it's kept here for 30 days, for everyone on this account to open, save or share.
files.kept_line: Each file is kept 30 days from its run, then goes away on its own. Everyone on this account sees these files. Your own chat attachments stay with their messages.
files.pick_one: Pick a file to see it here.
files.title: Files
